name: Musuta
source:
The ruler of Dungeon 4.

She was taken in by the previous Dragon King and raised like a sister alongside Rumi and Kissa.

Though a dark elf, her easygoing and laid-back nature makes her seem unlike a creature of darkness.

She acts as a guide when Kissa ventures into town. She has a tendency to unconsciously engage in combat when her dark heart becomes uncontrollable.

[From [url=https://fandc.co.jp/dragonsraid3/charactor06.html]Official website[/url]]
